title: Structured change-set context and external actor mapping for audit events
creator: Aditi Kumar
description:
Goal: define and deliver a single, extensible audit event shape that captures a human-readable narrative, a compact machine diff for changed state, and robust external-identity mapping for SSO/SAML/IdP-backed actors. This ticket covers schema design, backend ingestion + storage shape, and migration adapters for existing audit consumers (Console, Alerting, Incident playbooks, Compliance export).

Scope:
- Event taxonomy and required vs optional fields for admin actions (RBAC v2 changes), SSO-related events (SAML login/attribute changes), and service-to-service admin operations.
- Compact change-set encoding that works for both simple attribute updates and multi-field policy diffs; includes semantic ops and path notation.
- Actor identity model: canonicalize internal user, service account, IdP identity (SAML/OIDC subject), and impersonation chains with provenance hints.
- Causal context (request metadata) and integrity checks (content-hash + signature_hint) for later forensic analysis.
- Backwards-compatible adapter layer to continue populating older consumers during rollout.

Non-goals: full event retention policy decisions (separate compliance ticket), UI work beyond Console log parsing support, and on-prem migration packaging (handled by private deployment team).
acceptance_criteria: Schema document published in Design repo (Confluence) with examples for create/update/delete and complex RBAC policy diffs
Backend ingestion accepts new shape and stores a compact indexable payload without breaking existing exports (migration adapter implemented)
Console log viewer and infra alerting can map actor metadata for SSO-originated events
Security review completed and signed off by Security & Compliance
End-to-end test that shows a RBAC policy change event with actor chain, compact diff, and integrity hash stored and retrievable via audit API

notes_and_discussions: 2026-03-02: Initial design posted. Key decision: prefer ops-based compact diffs (op, path, value) instead of full-before/after blobs to save storage and speed queries.
2026-03-04: Security review requested: highlights for encryption-at-rest and KMS key usage for PII in actor.external_id fields.
2026-03-06: Design feedback from Platform: add request_id and tx_duration_ms to causal_context for tracing cost/latency-related admin failures.
2026-03-09: Marcus implemented prototype encoder and added round-trip unit tests; found edge-case with list-paths (policy.bindings[3].members[2]) — resolved by using bracket-indexing in path grammar.

2026-03-10: Decided to include a short narrative field (human_narrative) for Console display to improve oncall triage (e.g., 'Alice (idp:ACME-SAML) updated policy BillingAdmins: added svc-account:billing-ingest').
review_feedback: Security (2026-03-08): Ensure external_id fields are redaction-aware; add 'redaction_hint' and encryption at rest note.
Platform (2026-03-06): Querying compact diff by path must be indexable; recommend precompute path hashes for top-10 query patterns.
Console (2026-03-09): human_narrative is helpful but should be limited to 512 chars; fallback to generated summary if absent.
next_steps: Finish ingestion adapter and deploy to staging (end of week)
Run compatibility tests with audit-exporter and alerting pipelines
Complete security sign-off and update Design doc with redaction/encryption requirements
Schedule rollout: 2-week dual-write (new + legacy) then cutover
